# rich-click

> rich-click is a shim around the Python Click library that formats command line help text and error messages with Rich: colours, boxed option panels, Markdown and Rich markup in docstrings, and configurable styles.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://ewels.github.io/rich-click/1.9/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for rich-click, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://ewels.github.io/rich-click/1.9/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for rich-click
- [Documentation](https://ewels.github.io/rich-click/1.9/_llms-txt/documentation.txt): the prose guides: configuration, panels, styles, markup, CLI, Typer
- [Blog](https://ewels.github.io/rich-click/1.9/_llms-txt/blog.txt): release announcements and articles

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation

## Optional

- [rich_click API reference (Markdown)](https://ewels.github.io/rich-click/1.9/api/rich_click/llms.txt): Every documented module, class and function in rich_click.
